popup.title: Sailor's Crossing
popup.description: A pier-side cobblestone plaza with a fountain at its center and the site of a grizzly murder in [[1477 DR]].

popup.title: Admiral's Way
popup.description: A dockside [[salt]]-strewn street with the [[Low Lantern]] located at its eastern end.

popup.title: Loklee Street
popup.description: The street that owed its name to the small fishing village that eventually grew to be known as [[Baldur's Gate]]; it crossed with [[Stormshore Street]] in the north.

popup.title: Trade Way
popup.description: An ancient, long, well-traveled trade road along the west coast of [[Faerûn]].

popup.title: Coast Way
popup.description: A long, well-traveled part of the much larger [[Trade Way]] that started at [[Calimport]] in the south and went along the coastline all the way north to [[Waterdeep]].

popup.title: Stormshore Street
popup.description: A street that began in the northernmost top of the harbors, circled the [[Heapside]], passed [[Sorcerous Sundries]], hooked back west, and ended at the [[Stormshore Street Dock]] where the [[Low Lantern]] was [[anchor]]ed.

popup.title: Stormshore Street
popup.description: A street that began in the northernmost top of the harbors, circled the [[Heapside]], passed [[Sorcerous Sundries]], hooked back west, and ended at the [[Stormshore Street Dock]] where the [[Low Lantern]] was [[anchor]]ed.

popup.title: Stormshore Street
popup.description: A street that began in the northernmost top of the harbors, crossed [[Loklee Street]], circled the [[Heapside]], passed [[Sorcerous Sundries]], hooked back west, and ended at the [[Stormshore Street Dock]] where the [[Low Lantern]] was [[anchor]]ed.

popup.title: Bindle Street
popup.description: The street that began at the [[Old Wall (Baldur's Gate)|Old Wall]] by [[Felogyr's Fireworks]], ran south with a slight curve, passed the [[Blushing Mermaid]], crossed [[Stormshore Street]], and, eventually, ended at a dock near [[Fisher's Wharf]].

popup.title: Ulvur's Lane
popup.description: A short lane that rang along the southern side of the [[Old Wall (Baldur's Gate)|Old Wall]] from two city blocks west of the [[Gond Gate]].
popup.image: File:House of the Lute and Ulvur’s Lane.jpg

popup.title: Hammaskarl's Ride
popup.description: The street that began at the [[Basilisk Gate]], curved south, then moved west past [[Eastway Expeditions]], and ended on an interception with [[Loklee Street]].

popup.title: Talankar's Lane
popup.description: The street that began at the [[Basilisk Gate]] and ran northwest, passing the [[Blade and Stars]], the [[Elfsong Tavern]], and ended at the [[Heap Gate]].

popup.title: Windspell Street
popup.description: The street that stretched from the [[Citadel Gate]], passed [[Helm and Cloak]],  and separated the [[High House of Wonders]] from the [[Hall of Wonders]].

popup.title: Belltoll Street
popup.description: The street that began at [[The Wide]] by the [[Hlath (family)|Hlath Estate]], moved southwest past the [[High Hall]] and the [[Helm and Cloak]] inn, and ended soon after after crossing [[Sornbanner Street]].

popup.title: Wendserpent Street
popup.description: The street that began at [[Black Eel Street]], moved north through the [[Manor Gate]], crossed [[Belltoll Street]], then [[Windspell Street]], passed in front of the [[Black Dragon Gate]], curved along the city walls, passed [[Rose Portal]] shrine, and curved to [[the Wide]], where it ended.

popup.title: The Run
popup.description: Thr road that stretched from the [[Watch Citadel]] to the [[Black Dragon Gate]].

popup.title: Canary Lane
popup.description: A short shady lane with dark alleys that offered hiding spots for ne'er-do-well and an access point to the [[Baldur's Gate/Sewers|sewers]].

popup.title: Market Street
popup.description: The street with a butcher shop, rumored to serve monster meat in [[1477 DR]].

popup.title: The Western Wet
popup.description: The road that ran alongside the docks from the [[Seatower of Balduran]] to the [[Water Queen's House]].

popup.title: The Eastern Wet
popup.description: The street that ran alongside the docks and hugged the harbors from the drydocks on the northern edge of the [[Gray Harbor]] and ended at [[Waendel's Wharf]].

popup.title: Black Eel Street
popup.description: The road that began at [[Glaezel's Dock]] and moved in a straight line to the west until it ended at the city walls.
popup.image: File:Caundorl Street and Black Eel Street.png

popup.title: Caundorl Street
popup.description: The road that began at [[Hethkantle's Jetty]] and moved in a straight line to the west until it ended at the city walls.
popup.image: File:Caundorl Street and Black Eel Street.png

popup.title: Wendserpent Street
popup.description: The street that began at [[Black Eel Street]], moved north through the [[Manor Gate]], crossed [[Belltoll Street]], then [[Windspell Street]], passed in front of the [[Black Dragon Gate]], curved along the city walls, passed [[Rose Portal]] shrine, and curved to [[the Wide]], where it ended.

popup.title: Nuthkhal's Way
popup.description: The street that curved, connecting the [[Manycoins House]] with the [[Cliffgate]].

popup.title: Manyspears Lane
popup.description: The long lane that began at the [[Counting House]], passed the [[Baldur's Gate (gate)|Baldur's Gate]] and encircled [[The Wide]].

popup.title: Three Spires
popup.description: One of three major moots in [[Baldur's Gate]] – the intersection of [[Hauth Lane]], [[Wendserpent Street]], and [[Blackraven Lane]].

popup.title: Hauth Lane
popup.description: A short street that moved roughly north to south across the [[Three Spires]] intersection.

popup.title: Blackraven Lane
popup.description: A short street that moved roughly east to west across the [[Three Spires]] intersection, from the [[Sashenstar]] family estate to [[Chalsendace Street]].

popup.title: Chalsendace Street
popup.description: A street of wealth mansions; it stretched from the city walls to [[Stormcanter Street]] by the [[Old Wall (Baldur's Gate)|Old Wall]].

popup.title: Stormcanter Street
popup.description: A short street on the southern end of [[Chalsendace Street]].

popup.title: Fox Bottom
popup.description: One of three major moots in [[Baldur's Gate]]; it was located two city blocks south of [[Manycoins House]] along the [[Stormshore Street]] (formerly known as Long Lane) in a slummy area of run-down rooming-houses.

popup.title: Lathdell
popup.description: The small open plaza, or strake, in front of the [[Shrine of the Suffering]].

popup.title: Hulkael Street
popup.description: The street that once ran to and past the [[Manycoins House]], later, just stretched between the [[Lathdell]] plaza and [[Murl's Rest]] where the [[Sorcerous Sundries]] store was located.

popup.title: Murl's Rest
popup.description: The triangular plaza, or strake, in front of [[Sorcerous Sundries]].

popup.title: Lionsmoot
popup.description: One of three major moots in [[Baldur's Gate]], named after [[The House of the Lion]] [[festhall]] located on its eastern angle.

popup.title: Misty Court
popup.description: A street of note where the open-air stonemason's workshop, [[Alabaster Stonecrafts]], could be found.

popup.title: Trident Lane
popup.description: An area in the [[Seatower]] that housed many weapon smiths who serviced the [[Flaming Fist]]. One such shop was run by an automaton in the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]].

popup.title: Saint Sollars Way
popup.description: The street of note on which stood the home ot Mrs. [[Leventide]] in the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]].

popup.title: Old Town Avenue
popup.description: A street in the [[Lower City]] known for its expensive apartments and lodgings.

popup.title: Long Lane
popup.description: A short street that crossed [[Stormshore Street]] at the moot known as [[Fox Bottom]].

popup.title: Sornbanner Street
popup.description: The street that joined [[Belltoll Street]] at a moot in the west and [[Wendserpent Street]] at another moot to the east.
